programs.name: Computing Science (BSc or BA)
programs.a_level_offer: No fixed grade offer published. The admission average is calculated on at least three A-Level courses, or two A-Levels and two AS-Levels in different subject areas (certified GCSE results and predicted A-level results are required). Computing Science needs A/AS Level Math or Further Math plus one of A/AS Level Biology, Chemistry or Physics. Historical acceptance standard for students on a student visa: high 80s to low 90s.
programs.ib_offer: Full IB Diploma including at least three HL courses; minimum 26 points for consideration to all programs, competitive minimum varies by program (historical acceptance standard for Computing Science: high 80s to low 90s). Requires IB Math Analysis and Approaches HL or SL, or Applications and Interpretations HL (AI SL will not satisfy), and one of IB Biology, Chemistry or Physics at HL or SL. IB Predicted Grades Report required.
programs.ap_offer: US curriculum: at least three senior-level academic courses including English, with 70% in senior-level English and at least C-/60% in a junior or senior-level math course; senior-level Math and one senior-level Biology, Chemistry or Physics are required for Computing Science; interim transcript required. SAT or ACT is optional for Fall 2024 admission onwards (no disadvantage if not submitted). AP courses can replace required courses: AP Calculus AB/BC for Pre-Calculus 12/Calculus 12, AP Biology, Chemistry or Physics for the matching Grade 12 science.
programs.required_subjects: Math (A/AS Level Math or Further Math; IB Math AA HL/SL or AI HL; US senior-level Math) and one of Biology/Chemistry/Physics.
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 1-6 scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026): overall 4.5 with no part lower than 4.0. Tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (1-120 scale): overall 88 with no part less than 20. Single sitting; MyBest and TOEFL Essentials are not used.
programs.english_note: SFU English language requirement: also met by completing the last three years of full-time secondary education in English (Canada or an English-principal country) or four years at a recognized English-medium international school, each with 70% in a senior English course, or by an IB Diploma with English A (HL/SL) grade 3.
programs.notes: The program page does not state the degree length, so the course length is not shown. Fee: 2026/27 international tuition is $1,262.88 per unit for students who entered 2024/25 or later; $37,886 = 30 units a year at that basic rate (the SFU typical-costs page gives $18,943.20 tuition per 15-unit term); Computing Science courses at the 200/300/400 division cost more ($1,327.97 per unit), and co-op terms are $932.08 per term (https://www.sfu.ca/students/calendar/2026/fall/fees-and-regulations/tuition-fees/undergraduate.html , https://www.sfu.ca/students/financial-aid/plan/typical-costs.html). Fees for 2027/28 are not yet published and SFU says international fees may rise by up to 6% a year. Deadline: Fall 2027 applications open 1 Oct 2026, deadline 31 Jan 2027, all admission documents due 28 Feb 2027 (https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/apply/dates-deadlines/high-school/fall-term.html). Requirements: US https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/usa-highschool.html ; UK https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/international-highschool/country/united-kingdom.html ; IB https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/international-baccalaureate.html ; AP https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/advanced-placement.html ; grade ranges https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/historical-admission-grade-ranges.html (guide only, no guarantee). The program page lists degree as Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts, Faculty of Applied Sciences.

programs.name: Economics (BA or BSc)
programs.a_level_offer: No fixed grade offer published. The admission average is calculated on at least three A-Level courses, or two A-Levels and two AS-Levels in different subject areas (certified GCSE results and predicted A-level results are required). No additional faculty or program course prerequisites. Historical acceptance standard for Arts and Social Sciences programs for students on a student visa: mid 80s.
programs.ib_offer: Full IB Diploma including at least three HL courses; minimum 26 points for consideration to all programs, competitive minimum varies by program (historical acceptance standard for Arts and Social Sciences programs: mid 80s for students on a student visa). No additional course prerequisites beyond the general requirements. IB Predicted Grades Report required.
programs.ap_offer: US curriculum: at least three senior-level academic courses including English, with 70% in senior-level English and at least C-/60% in a junior or senior-level math course; Economics (Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences) has no additional program course prerequisites; interim transcript required. SAT or ACT is optional for Fall 2024 admission onwards (no disadvantage if not submitted).
programs.required_subjects: No program-specific course prerequisites; general requirements only (including 70% in senior-level English and the Quantitative and Analytical Skills requirement, e.g. C-/60% in a junior or senior math course for US applicants).
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 1-6 scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026): overall 4.5 with no part lower than 4.0. Tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (1-120 scale): overall 88 with no part less than 20. Single sitting; MyBest and TOEFL Essentials are not used.
programs.english_note: SFU English language requirement: also met by completing the last three years of full-time secondary education in English (Canada or an English-principal country) or four years at a recognized English-medium international school, each with 70% in a senior English course, or by an IB Diploma with English A (HL/SL) grade 3.
programs.notes: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences, Department of Economics; both a BA and a BSc in Economics exist and the program page says you can start at the Burnaby or Surrey campus. The page does not state the degree length, so the course length is not shown. Deadline: Fall 2027 applications open 1 Oct 2026, deadline 31 Jan 2027, all admission documents due 28 Feb 2027 (https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/apply/dates-deadlines/high-school/fall-term.html). Requirements: US https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/usa-highschool.html ; UK https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/international-highschool/country/united-kingdom.html ; IB https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/international-baccalaureate.html ; AP https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/advanced-placement.html ; grade ranges https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/historical-admission-grade-ranges.html (guide only, no guarantee).

programs.name: Engineering Science (BASc)
programs.a_level_offer: No fixed grade offer published. The admission average is calculated on at least three A-Level courses, or two A-Levels and two AS-Levels in different subject areas (certified GCSE results and predicted A-level results are required). Engineering Science needs A/AS Level Math or Further Math, A/AS Level Chemistry and A/AS Level Physics. Historical acceptance standard for Engineering Sciences / Mechatronic Systems Engineering for students on a student visa: mid 80s.
programs.ib_offer: Full IB Diploma including at least three HL courses; minimum 26 points for consideration to all programs, competitive minimum varies by program (historical acceptance standard for Engineering Sciences / Mechatronic Systems Engineering: mid 80s). Requires IB Math Analysis and Approaches HL or SL, or Applications and Interpretations HL (AI SL will not satisfy), IB Chemistry HL or SL and IB Physics HL or SL. IB Predicted Grades Report required.
programs.ap_offer: US curriculum: at least three senior-level academic courses including English, with 70% in senior-level English and at least C-/60% in a junior or senior-level math course; Engineering Science needs senior-level Math, senior-level Chemistry and senior-level Physics; interim transcript required. SAT or ACT is optional for Fall 2024 admission onwards (no disadvantage if not submitted). AP courses can replace required courses: AP Calculus AB/BC for Pre-Calculus 12/Calculus 12, AP Chemistry for Chemistry 12, AP Physics 1, 2 or C for Physics 12.
programs.required_subjects: Math, Chemistry and Physics (A/AS Level; IB Math AA HL/SL or AI HL, IB Chemistry, IB Physics; US senior-level courses).
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 1-6 scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026): overall 4.5 with no part lower than 4.0. Tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (1-120 scale): overall 88 with no part less than 20. Single sitting; MyBest and TOEFL Essentials are not used.
programs.english_note: SFU English language requirement: also met by completing the last three years of full-time secondary education in English (Canada or an English-principal country) or four years at a recognized English-medium international school, each with 70% in a senior English course, or by an IB Diploma with English A (HL/SL) grade 3.
programs.notes: Faculty of Applied Sciences, School of Engineering Science: mandatory co-op, and students specialize in one of five options by third year (Biomedical, Computer, Electronics, Engineering Physics, Systems). Mechatronic Systems Engineering is a separate SFU program with the same course requirements and was not chosen because Engineering Science is the broader entry. The program page does not state the degree length or campus, so the course length is not shown. Fee: 2026/27 international tuition is $1,262.88 per unit for students who entered 2024/25 or later; $37,886 = 30 units a year at that rate (the SFU typical-costs page gives $18,943.20 tuition per 15-unit term); 200/300/400 division courses in Engineering Science cost more ($1,348.19 per unit) and co-op terms are $932.08 per term (https://www.sfu.ca/students/calendar/2026/fall/fees-and-regulations/tuition-fees/undergraduate.html , https://www.sfu.ca/students/financial-aid/plan/typical-costs.html). 2027/28 fees are not yet published and SFU says international fees may rise by up to 6% a year. Deadline: Fall 2027 applications open 1 Oct 2026, deadline 31 Jan 2027, all admission documents due 28 Feb 2027 (https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/apply/dates-deadlines/high-school/fall-term.html). Requirements: US https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/usa-highschool.html ; UK https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/international-highschool/country/united-kingdom.html ; IB https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/international-baccalaureate.html ; AP https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/advanced-placement.html ; grade ranges https://www.sfu.ca/students/admission/admission-requirements/historical-admission-grade-ranges.html (guide only, no guarantee).
